name: POST /api/voice-agent/stack-profiles - Create a stack profile from a preset
description: Clones a preset (budget | balanced | premium) into a tenant stack profile, applying optional per-layer overrides, and binds provider credentials BY REFERENCE: credential_refs maps a layer (telephony, stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts) to {primary, secondary?} ai-gateway tenant-credential binding ids — never raw keys. Covers deef80bf-b0ce-4295-9cf0-878c4f5bfd02#AC3: a tenant can create a stack profile from a preset, and the create is REJECTED with 422 CredentialInvalid when any referenced credential does not exist for the tenant or is revoked. tenant_id may be omitted (taken from the JWT); if given it must match the JWT tenant or the call is 403 Forbidden. `complete` in the response is true only when every required layer has a primary credential. Names are unique per tenant (409 Conflict).

testCases.name: Create a balanced profile with the tenant's OpenAI key on the fast LLM layer
Reject a referenced credential that does not exist for the tenant

errorCases.when: preset_key is not budget, balanced or premium
a layer key outside telephony, stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts

errorCases.message: tenant_id does not match the authenticated tenant
errorCases.when: body tenant_id differs from the JWT tenant_id

errorCases.message: a stack profile with this name already exists
errorCases.when: name already used by the tenant

errorCases.message: credential <binding_id> for layer <layer> is missing or revoked
errorCases.when: a referenced binding id does not exist for the tenant or its status is revoked
